area: O6 codec scratch and actual Minecraft decoding
hypothesis: Use actual production chunk NBT to quantify compressor reuse, repeated scratch zero-filling, retained compressed payloads and real Minecraft read/decode costs before changing ownership or introducing pooling.

decision.retained: Codec-only production-source benchmark example and evidence. It uses the same conditional allocator as production and checks stable encoded output.
decision.runtime: Reject grow-only zlib scratch prototype. About1.1% reproducible codec-phase benefit (~1ms per1024records) did not establish complete-MCA benefit in the required CPU/Metal trials; all production-code and added codec-test edits restored.
decision.pooling: No production pooling/TLS added: extending the modeled encoder batch8 to1024 produced no useful gain in this exploratory codec-only workload.
decision.scope_remaining: This does not complete all native palette/NBT construction work or actual Bukkit delivery profiling.

baseline.scope: actual Minecraft RegionFileStorage and SerializableChunkData parsing; no live activation or generation

candidate.scope: actual Minecraft RegionFileStorage and SerializableChunkData parsing; no live activation or generation

minecraft_decoding.scope: Two separate JVM runs, two formats, six passes of1024chunks/file:24,576read/parse operations over repeated fixtures, not24,576uniquechunks or live server/Bukkit activation. Different JVM timing windows are not a controlled codec-prototype speed comparison.

baseline_jfr_attribution.scope: Owned RegionDecodeBenchmark: setup plus actual Minecraft IO/decompression/NBT/chunk parsing. Stack-based attribution, not a server/live/Bukkit activation profile. Missing/truncated stacks can remain unattributed.
baseline_jfr_attribution.allocation_scope: jdk.ObjectAllocationSample weighted byte estimates, not exact allocation counts or a memory/RSS measurement.

development_notes: Initial example build used ? on a libdeflater error without StdError, then needed mutable bound-query compressor; both compile errors fixed and failed logs retained externally.
Initial system-allocator example cases were exploratory; final baselines explicitly select production mimalloc.
jfr print defaults to a shallow rendered stack. Attribution was corrected by re-rendering the same recording with --stack-depth256; no inferred phase is substituted for missing/truncated stacks.
A multi-file candidate patch failed atomic context verification and made no changes; corrected patch passed all tests and was later rejected for performance.

model_limits: Logical fill counts derive Vec resize lengths from actual raw/packed sizes; they are not measured DRAM traffic, allocations, elapsed-time shares or GPU utilization.
Fixed example batch sizes are an explicit codec-only reuse model, not an inventory of actual Rayon map_init jobs.
Example timing includes Encoder setup/compression/retained Record allocation and excludes NBT construction, terrain, lighting, publication, decoding and Record destruction.
Per-process micro distributions and paired process medians must not be confused with whole-MCA throughput.
Moving bound-sized buffers into each Record could retain much more than the7.2MBzlib packed payload; no copy-removal implementation is accepted from a byte count alone.
release: No release or distribution JAR build.
